defects.title: When data wrangling fails after all retries the analyst replies "Workflow completed." and the error never reaches the response (business-science/ai-data-science-team#90)
defects.expected_behavior: After the wrangler exhausts its fix attempts, the analyst should report the failure (the last error) to the user and not mark the step as a successful completion.
defects.observed_behavior: In both rounds, steps 3 and 5 exhausted the wrangler's 3 fix attempts (4 failed executions, last errors "No module named 'pyproj'" / Timestamp JSON serialization) and the analyst replied only 'Workflow completed.' with step status succeeded; the error never reached the response. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (212f3981b1f7).
